entries.final_answer: Derive the cap from measurement. Operator guidance (batch-11 D1 brief): measure first, do not just raise the number; a cancellation must not read as a failure. Measured: p95 20.3 min = 102% of the 20-min cap; fixed costs (whole-tree collection ~8 min, serial wall-clock policy scan ~3.5 min on PRs) are architectural -- tests/ci/test_corpus_blocking_home.py requires tree-wide corpus reach and tests/ci/test_contracts_routing.py requires exactly one pytest invocation, so a path shard would weaken the lane. Fix: record the measured max suite in the repo's #5378 headroom form, derive the cap with ceil((max+0:30)*1.5) = 31, extend the cap guard to enforce it for this job, and make a budget expiry read as INCOMPLETE-advisory rather than a failed test (#4437). Selection semantics, deselects, continue-on-error and trigger stay unchanged.
